svg.title: Four equal contributions to one destination pixel
svg.desc: At the center of a two by two source, every pixel contributes one quarter. RGB red values 0, 100, 200 and 240 give 135. Nearest instead chooses 240 under the higher-coordinate tie rule.

g.font-family: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: A center pixel has four equally weighted neighbors
Pixel values are illustrative. This byte-space operation does not perform area antialiasing.
